  WEDNESDAY, JANUARY 10, 2024
  1150 E. 4TH STREET
  LONG BEACH SENIOR CENTER, ROOM 202, 10:00 AM

Naida Tushnet, Chair  Allan Goldstein, Commissioner
Michele Valencia, Vice Chair  Carolyn Hines, Commissioner
Norma Chinchilla, Commissioner  Phyllis Schmidt, Commissioner
Robert Finney, Commissioner  William Smith, Commissioner
Sheila Gibbons, Commissioner

CALL TO ORDER

ROLL CALL

PLEDGE OF ALLEGIANCE

REGULAR AGENDA

1.  24-51733  Recommendation to approve the minutes for the Advisory Commission on Aging
  meeting of Wednesday, December 13, 2023.

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

2.  24-51740  Recommendation to receive and file a presentation on Homeless Seniors by Jamie
  Wilson.

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

3.  24-51735  Recommendation to receive and file an update from the Recreation
  Superintendent, Heidi Mazas.

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

4.  24-51734  Recommendation to hold an election for the position of Chair and Vice Chair of the
  Advisory Commission on Aging.

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

5.  24-51736  Recommendation to receive and file reports from current standing committees.

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

6.  24-51739  Recommendation to review and discuss standing committee members.

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

PUBLIC COMMENT

Opportunity to address the Advisory Commission on Aging on non-agenda items. Each speaker is
limited to three minutes to make their comments unless extended by the Chair.

ANNOUNCEMENTS

ADJOURNMENT

I, Irene Rodriguez, Clerk Typist, certify that the agenda was posted not less than 72 hours prior to
the meeting.

NOTE: The agenda and supporting documents are available online at
https://longbeach.gov/meetings. If a special accommodation is desired pursuant to the Americans
with Disabilities Act, please contact Irene Rodriguez at 562-570-3538 by 12 noon, the day prior to
the meeting.
